clientSourceReview.sdk: AttachVPC sends one POST /bare-metals/{id}/vpcs/attach and does not call Reboot.

clientSourceReview.apiSpecification: Attachment accepts vpc_id and documents HTTP 204. It does not state whether the backend restarts the host.
clientSourceReview.interpretation: No client-triggered reboot in the inspected SDK/Terraform paths. Backend-triggered reboot and immediate private NIC activation remain unverified.
